item.title: Kyuzen 0.2.0
item.description:
Split view: show two tabs side by side.

  • Drag a sidebar row to the edge of the page, drop one row onto the middle of another, choose it from a row's menu, press Cmd+Option+S, or type "split" in the command box.
  • A split shows as one row in the sidebar. Point at it and drag the handle between its halves to move it; drag either half away to end the split.
  • A pinned split stays together when moved, filed in a folder or restored after a relaunch.

Fixes: the window can be moved again; a pinned tab no longer comes back a second time in Today after a relaunch; a row can be dropped at the very bottom of Pinned; dragging the split divider no longer redraws the sidebar.

item.title: Kyuzen 0.1.1
item.description:
This release exists to prove that updating works: if you are reading this inside Kyuzen, it did.

The About page now shows Kyuzen's own version, and Settings carries a choice for how updates arrive: ask first, install quietly, or never check.

item.title: Kyuzen 0.1.0
item.description:
The first release of Kyuzen: a Chromium browser with a vertical sidebar, spaces bound to separate logins, a command box, peek and split-free navigation.

This release exists to prove that updating works. It is signed ad-hoc rather than with a Developer ID, so macOS will warn when you open it by hand.
